description:
Hand text or a file to another AI app (or another session) with a short, speakable code like "amber-otter-mango-42", which is also a link: https://agentanthill.com/amber-otter-mango-42.
Use it when a person is moving work between AI assistants (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, a phone assistant): give them the say_this line. Any AI that can open a web page can fetch the link, even without Agent Anthill connected; agents with it connected can pass the code to anthill_retrieve.
Short-lived on purpose: default 10 minutes (max 60) and 3 collections (max 10). Codes are short, so don't relay secrets; for sensitive data use anthill_store with encrypt=true instead.
Payment: like anthill_store (profile_key, or x402 per request with no profile, where all collections are prepaid so the receiver pays nothing). Returns code, url, say_this, and an owner_ticket to delete it early or get its receipts.

content.description: Text, or base64 if is_base64 is true.

content_type.description: Optional MIME type. Text is best for AI receivers.

is_base64.description: True if content is base64-encoded binary.

label.description: Optional note shown to the receiver, e.g. 'Draft from ChatGPT session'.

minutes.description: How long the code works. Default 10, max 60.

profile_key.description: Your profile's secret key (starts with 'anthill_sk_'). Optional if sent as an 'Authorization: Bearer' header.

uses.description: How many times it can be collected. Default 3 (link previews in chat apps can use one).

name: anthill_relay
title: Relay to another AI with a short code
